_comment: Model Context Protocol client configuration. Each entry defines a stdio MCP server the app can spawn on demand to load dynamic tools. Servers are opt-in: the trading engine only connects to a server when a node explicitly requests its tools. In PAPER_TRADING mode the broker (groww) server stays disabled.

groww.description: Local Groww broker MCP server for order routing. DISABLED by default in paper mode; enable only after the broker adapter is proven.

brave-search.description: Web search MCP for regulatory filings, corporate disclosures and news catalysts. Used by the analyst node.

duckduckgo.description: Fallback zero-key web search MCP. Used when Brave is not configured.

filesystem.description: Local filesystem MCP for reading/writing logs and audit artifacts.
